name: Ring of Foe Protection
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of protection. Instead of giving the wearer a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to his AC, the bonus is given to the wearer’s opponent against attacks made by the wearer.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it, which renders the ring non-magical.

If this ring should ever come into contact with a ring of protection with an equal or lesser deflection bonus, it explodes inflicting 6d6 points of damage to all targets within 5 feet of the wearer (DC 15 Reflex for half damage).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of protection

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
